content:
Renaissance Philanthropy are funding a summer fellowship to come and work with my group formalizing statements of modern research level theorems. The opportunity is open to Master's and PhD students. Preference will be given to applicants who are able to come to London and work with us in person. The job ad is here

https://docs.google.com/document/d/1go6iXOXAaHmM7N32FSwImTkw3QerHahe/edit

In short: come and experiment with new tools and see if they help us to formalize hard modern theorem statements.

Deadline April 10th.
